lines.text: بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم و به نستعین
lines.en: In the name of God, the Merciful, the Compassionate, and in Him we seek help.

lines.text: سپاس و ستایش مالک الملکی را که بنظر شفقت و مرحمت سیاحان عالم خاک را بسباحان
lines.en: Praise and thanksgiving to the Owner of the Kingdom, who with a look of compassion and mercy, [connected] the travelers of the world of dust to the swimmers

lines.text: محیط افلاک اشنا و مربوط ساخت و انتقالات اجرام علوی را باعث امتزاجات اجسام
lines.en: of the ocean of the spheres, and made the movements of the celestial bodies the cause of the mixtures of the terrestrial bodies,

lines.text: سفلی کرد و قالب وجود نوع انسانرا قابل ادراک حقایق و دقایق صنایع خود گردانید که
lines.en: and made the mold of the existence of the human species capable of perceiving the truths and subtleties of His crafts, so that

lines.text: از منازل سافله بمراتب عالیه انتقال و تحویل فرمود و از ایشان اهل سعادت را از ظلمت
lines.en: He transferred and transformed them from the lower stations to the higher ranks, and from among them, He brought the people of felicity out of the darkness

lines.text: غوایة انصراف فرموده بنور هدایة رسانید واکمل وافضل بشر را که محمد مصطفی است
lines.en: of error and led them to the light of guidance, and the most perfect and excellent of mankind, who is Muhammad the Chosen,

lines.text: صلی الله علیه واله وسلم درجه اعلی نبوت و مرتبه قصوای رسالت کرامت فرمود و پیغمبر
lines.en: may God bless him and his family and grant them peace, He honored with the highest degree of prophethood and the utmost rank of messengership, and the Prophet

lines.text: اخر الزمان لقب داد و باب مدینه علم و خازن سر او را که مظهر عجایب و مظهر غرایب است
lines.en: of the End of Time He titled him, and the gate of the city of knowledge and the treasurer of His secret, who is the manifestation of wonders and the manifestation of marvels,

lines.text: بخلافت او تعیین کرد اولاد و احفاد او را که از غایة شهرت و ظهور از تعریف و توصیف
lines.en: He appointed to his caliphate, and his children and grandchildren, who due to the utmost fame and manifestation are independent of definition and description,

lines.text: مستغنی اند تاج کرامت بر سر نهاد خلعت امامت پوشانید و بحکم صحیح مثل اهل بیتی کمثل
lines.en: He placed the crown of honor on their heads, clothed them in the robe of Imamate, and by the authentic decree, 'The likeness of my Ahl al-Bayt is like the likeness of

lines.text: سفینة نوح رهنمای اهل نجات کرد صلوات الله وسلامه علیه وعلیهم اجمعین اما بعد
lines.en: the Ark of Noah,' He made them the guides of the people of salvation, may the blessings and peace of God be upon him and upon them all. As for what follows,

lines.text: چنین گوید ذره احقر و بنده کمترین محمد قاسم منجم مظفر که چون همیشه خاطر فیض ماثر
lines.en: thus says the most insignificant atom and the lowest servant, Muhammad Qasim the astrologer, Muzaffar, that since always the grace-emanating mind

lines.text: و همواره ضمیر منیر پادشاه جمجاه ستاره سپاه مظهر لطف الهی حامی دین مبین یعنے
lines.en: and the ever-luminous conscience of the Jamshid-like king with a star-like army, the manifestation of divine grace, the protector of the manifest religion, that is,

lines.text: الملقب بکلب استان علی ابوالمظفر شاه عباس الحسینی الصفوی الموسوی خلد الله ملکه و
lines.en: the one titled the dog of the threshold of Ali, Abu al-Muzaffar Shah Abbas al-Husayni al-Safawi al-Musawi, may God perpetuate his kingdom and

sections.text:
هو العلیم الخبیر
هذا کتاب التنبیهات من مؤلفات محمد قاسم بن مظفر
غفر الله له وعفی عنه
sections.en:
He is the Knowing, the Aware.
This is the book of al-Tanbīhāt, among the compositions of Muḥammad Qāsim ibn Muẓaffar.
May God forgive him and pardon him.

He is the Knowing, the Aware,
the Mighty

summary.headline: Invocation and Dedication
summary.text: Opening invocation and preface to Muhammad Qasim Muẓaffar’s astrological work, praising God, Muhammad, ʿAlī, the Ahl al-Bayt, and the Safavid ruler Shah ʿAbbās. It describes celestial motions as causes of terrestrial mixtures and presents human beings as capable of perceiving divine and astrological truths.
